Whole blood and serum samples are collected from healthy dogs, dogs with non-oncologic disease, and dogs diagnosed with certain cancers to develop and validate the new testing modalities. Eligibility Criteria: For full inclusion criteria, reach out to the participating hospitals directly Dogs that weigh ≥ 4lbs Dogs with a cancer diagnosis Dogs that are cancer treatment naive Study Timeline Single clinic visit for diagnostics and sample submission Interested in this study?
